entities.summary: Marko Bošnjak is a Slovenian jurist, judge, attorney, and academic. He worked as a researcher and lecturer before becoming an attorney and subsequently a judge. Bošnjak served as a judge at the European Court of Human Rights between May 2016 and May 2025. For the last 11 months of his term, he was the president of the court. In June 2025, he was appointed as a judge at the European Court of Justice.

entities.summary: Marko Bošnjak is a Slovenian jurist, judge, attorney, and academic. He worked as a researcher and lecturer before becoming an attorney and subsequently a judge. Bošnjak served as a judge at the European Court of Human Rights between May 2016 and May 2025. For the last 11 months of his term, he was the president of the court. In June 2025, he was appointed as a judge at the European Court of Justice.
